scope: Explicit development simulation policies and remaining acceptance, not a native comparison result.

gaps.reference: Character root declares 0.625 base AS, a -0.07083333283662796 cast offset and no explicit cast-offset AS coefficient.
gaps.localObservation: Conventional (0.3 + offset) / AS calculation produces a 22-tick base windup; ordinary level/item scaling uses the shared combat path.
gaps.acceptance: Measure native ordinary and critical release/recovery at multiple levels/attack speeds; compare cancellation and target loss.

gaps.reference: Q attack child explicitly declares mCastTime=0.25, canCastWhileDisabled=true and mCantCancelWhileWindingUp=true; legacy cast/total fields differ.
gaps.localObservation: Fixed fifteen-tick windup, preserved committed swing, release reset and a provisional 53-tick automatic cycle. A fresh explicit attack order can bypass recovery.
gaps.acceptance: Native cast-to-contact and automatic/manual follow-up traces, including attack speed, CC, Flash, displacement and fog/target loss.

gaps.reference: No Q empowerment lifetime or empowered bonus range is established by the retained character BIN. Its self-cast range is not an attack bonus.
gaps.localObservation: Six-second empowerment and +50 attack range, including exact expiry before new commands. A previously committed hit survives expiry.
gaps.acceptance: Controlled native activation/expiry and attack-range boundary captures before player/production acceptance.

gaps.reference: Current named Q damage and stun are retained separately from the stale child damage coefficient.
gaps.localObservation: Separate physical/magic payloads, basic-only critical scaling, shared shields/tenacity and Sunlight application/ally consumption are implemented. Ward-specific behavior and native interactions remain open.
gaps.acceptance: Complete Sunlight, ward/structure effects, spell shields, immunity/dodge/block, attribution and native interaction matrix.

gaps.reference: Riot includes Sunlight among damage enchantments whose caster owns damage effects while the buffed ally receives kill credit.
gaps.localObservation: Leona owns proc damage/effects and an allied distinct champion receives kill/reward credit. Saved contributions retain delegated credit for later executions. Ordinary later damage replaces it.
gaps.acceptance: Verify caster-side effects, ally kill credit, support contributions, lethal/shielded/blocked hits, multiple Leona ownership and saved futures. Do not substitute ordinary damage-source attribution.

gaps.reference: Frozen duration/damage and published ally-damage text do not specify every trigger, stacking or ordering detail.
gaps.localObservation: Single target mark; last-caster refresh/replacement; current-level consumption; caster-death persistence; positive champion-owned damage except cleanup, including shield absorption; consumption before Scorchclaw; non-structure/non-ward enemies including monsters.
gaps.acceptance: Native comparison for multiple Leona, pets/procs/summoners, spell shields/blocked hits, source death and item ordering.

gaps.reference: Published proc ownership does not specify every monster-aggro interaction after source death.
gaps.localObservation: Living damage owner is eligible for aggro; otherwise living delegated ally is used. Other posthumous damage preserves current aggro or starts idle-camp recovery. Returning monsters clear target and use a home move order. Scuttler preserves patrol and updates its recovery clock.
gaps.acceptance: Native source/trigger ownership, posthumous hits, grouped camps and Scuttler comparison.

gaps.reference: Frozen W ArmorMRDuration is three seconds; tooltip describes an explosion and resistance extension on hit. Authored instant cast timing is absent, and display range 450 differs from raw cast radius 500.
gaps.localObservation: Instant cast preserves orders/windups. One pre-command burst after 180 ticks uses current position/AP and captured rank, inclusive 450-plus-target-radius overlap without vision/LOS. Eligible shielded/lethal hits extend both defenses 180 ticks; misses retire it. Death cancels; victory clears.
gaps.acceptance: Native cast/input/expiry order, radius/hitbox and terrain/fog boundaries, shield/immunity eligibility, exact extension scope, death and displacement matrix.

gaps.reference: Named flat reduction/max fraction, resistance base arrays and 20% other-bonus coefficients are exported. Tooltip formulas do not establish all runtime modifier ordering.
gaps.localObservation: Stored stats exclude W; live bonuses subtract per-level-rounded base stats, avoiding self scaling and phantom bonus from float growth. Amplification then capped flat reduction then resistance/percentage mitigation then shields; true damage bypasses. Total armor is shredded afterward. Companion bonus scaling uses pre-shred totals.
gaps.acceptance: Native dynamic recalculation, negative/reduced bonus stats, amplification/flat/reduction/shield order, periodic/multi-hit effects and true damage comparison.

gaps.reference: Root declares mCastTime=0.25 and uncancellable windup. Child missile declares speed 2000, width 70, projected range 900; tooltip selects last champion for root/dash.
gaps.localObservation: Captured direction/rank/AP; release-tick movement; width-as-radius inclusive sweeps; distance/identity ordering; unique hits; no LOS requirement. Last champion is rooted only at full flight completion. Dead final target prevents pursuit without fallback.
gaps.acceptance: Native width interpretation, hit/endpoint boundaries, root/dash dispatch timing, overlapping/moving targets, blocked/immune/hidden contacts, death and Flash-windup matrix.

gaps.reference: Retained character data does not establish native dash speed, endpoint, homing or interruption rules. Missile speed is not dash speed evidence.
gaps.localObservation: Provisional 2000-unit/s homing to near-side body contact, terrain traversal with reachable landing/interruption. Root/stun/Flash/target death end pursuit; orders buffer. Existing Daybreak can release without adding normal movement. Turret retaliation is retained.
gaps.acceptance: Native speed/landing/homing, terrain/displacement and interrupt traces, Flash overlap, Q/W timing, buffered commands, turret attack clocks and aggro near walls.

gaps.reference: Root declares uncancellable windup and legacy spellCastTime=0.25 but no explicit mCastTime or impact delay. Named damage/CC/range values are exported; legacy on-hit and cherry fields remain excluded.
gaps.localObservation: 15-tick walking lock; fixed impact after 38 ticks (local 0.625s rounded up). Captured ground point/rank/AP, range clamp, Q/W and released E overlap. Death before release cancels; release-boundary/posthumous impacts persist.
gaps.acceptance: Native cast-to-release/impact, interrupts, displacement/Flash, E/Q/W overlap, buffered input and death/respawn order before player acceptance.

gaps.reference: Authored radii 120/300, 1.75-second control and 80% slow. mSpellRevealsChampion=false does not settle native area vision.
gaps.localObservation: Pre-command impact, current positions, ID order, inclusive radius-plus-body overlap; center stun or outer slow; no LOS gate; no separate area vision. Shared shields/tenacity, source-owned Sunlight and ordinary neutral reset rules.
gaps.acceptance: Native boundaries/target sampling, area/hit/caster reveal, spell shields, immunity, CC and monster aggro comparison. Correct or complete vision before full acceptance.

gaps.reference: Retained 81-bone rig, 23 clips, 608016 keys and normals. Source ordinary slots have weights 0.5/0.5/0; Recall declares {b4dcde19}, Idle3, Idle1.
gaps.localObservation: NPC development browser uses own rig and saved clocks. Stateless two-slot swing choice, critical override, captured Eclipse swing, W idle/run, Q contact/recovery retiming, E/dash/R body playback and shared 80ms fades are local policies. Unlit source diffuse material; no native shader or spell-effect equivalence claimed.
gaps.acceptance: Native graph dispatch, playback rates/locks, masks/blends, reflection/gloss/shading, full source spell VFX/audio, human controls, support AI and production roster acceptance remain required.
